title: Last Modified
summary: A date-painting that reads its own file-age live off the medium and loses it the instant you copy the file.
mechanism: document.lastModified (host/filesystem Last-Modified for this very file) + Intl.RelativeTimeFormat recomputed every second; the age, stamp and hue are all minted from the birth instant, which reproduction resets to now.
references: On Kawara, I Am Still Alive (1970- )
Walter Benjamin, The Work of Art in the Age of Mechanical Reproduction (1935)
